steps.say: One faulty trypsin gene can burn the pancreas from within, passed down through generations. The digestive enzyme wakes up inside the gland instead of the gut.
steps.tx: One faulty trypsin gene burns the pancreas from within. Hereditary pancreatitis is **autosomal dominant** (one copy suffices) with high penetrance from **PRSS1** (trypsin gene) cationic **trypsinogen** (trypsin precursor) mutation on **7q35** (chromosome seven region thirty five), usually R122H or N29I, causing trypsin autoactivation that resists deactivation. Trypsin wakes inside the gland instead of the gut.

steps.say: Think genes when belly attacks repeat in childhood without gallstones. Two unexplained bouts or affected relatives should trigger testing.
steps.tx: Think genes when attacks repeat without reason. It causes under **1 percent** (one percent) of chronic pancreatitis with bouts from **5 to 10 years** (five to ten years) without gallstones or divisum marking the **age of onset** (childhood start), and any child with **2** (two) unexplained attacks of **recurrent pancreatitis** (repeat gland burns) or a **family history** (affected relatives) deserves testing. Two strikes without stones means genes.

vis.alt: Diagram comparing normal pancreas with chronic pancreatitis showing fibrosis, calcifications, inflammation and atrophy.
vis.caption: Repeated burns scar the gland into fibrosis, calcification and atrophy. Two unexplained childhood attacks or affected relatives trigger gene testing. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: The same gene threatens cancer decades later, so counsel families early and start camera screening of the gland at thirty. Adult care carries the watch lifelong.
steps.tx: The same gene threatens cancer decades later. Lifetime **pancreatic adenocarcinoma** (gland cancer) risk rises **50 to 70 fold** (fifty to seventy fold) to **40 percent** (forty percent) by age **70** (seventy), so **cancer surveillance** (planned cancer hunt) with **endoscopic ultrasound** (inside scope scan) screening starts at age **30** (thirty). Counsel families early; adult care continues the watch lifelong.

steps.say: A split drainage from a fusion failure explains some unexplained attacks. Most carriers never know, but a minority earn bouts from childhood into adult life.
steps.tx: A fusion failure splits the drainage. **Pancreas divisum** (split gland) is failed ventral and dorsal fusion leaving dorsal **Santorini duct** (upper channel) and ventral **Wirsung duct** (main channel) drainage, presenting variably from childhood to adulthood. Most carriers never know; a minority earn bouts of unexplained pancreatitis.

steps.say: Map the whole duct with MRI before blaming the split, because the scope dye test only fills the lower channel. Seeing divisum does not prove guilt.
steps.tx: Map the whole duct before blaming it. Magnetic resonance beats endoscopic retrograde study by showing the whole **dorsal pancreatic duct** (upper channel) where retrograde views only the ventral duct, so **MRCP** (pancreas MRI) outranks **ERCP** (scope dye test) for diagnosis, and divisum as a pancreatitis cause stays controversial. Seeing divisum in a pancreatitis child does not prove guilt.

steps.say: A pinhole outlet can choke the upper duct, swelling it behind the blockage. Reserve knives for proven obstruction with a fat dorsal duct.
steps.tx: A pinhole outlet can choke the upper duct. Forced flow through the small **minor papilla** (tiny outlet) obstructs and dilates the dorsal duct, treated by transduodenal **sphincteroplasty** (outlet widening) or **Puestow procedure** (duct to bowel join) when dilated or obstructed. Reserve knives for proven obstruction with a fat dorsal duct.

steps.say: Gallbladder disease now visits children too as teen weight rises. Ask about fatty food triggers and family stones in every teen with upper belly pain.
steps.tx: Gallbladder disease now visits children too. Rising teen **obesity** (excess weight) brings **cholelithiasis** (gallstones) and gallbladder **biliary dyskinesia** (lazy gallbladder) into paediatric clinics with classic biliary colic and epigastric pain. Ask about fatty food triggers and family stones in every teen with upper belly pain.

steps.say: Numbers plus story decide the gallbladder, never numbers alone. A low squeeze score that matches the classic pain supports removal, while vague aches need another cause first.
steps.tx: Numbers plus story decide the gallbladder. A cholecystokinin **HIDA scan** (tracer squeeze test) **ejection fraction** (squeeze percent) under **35 percent** (thirty five percent) matching colic supports **cholecystectomy** (gallbladder removal), while vague noncolicky pain needs another cause first. Never remove a gallbladder for numbers alone without the classic pain.
